ann.t: Newspaper Clippings of publication of Un-audited Financial results for quarter ended 30th September,2026.

SBEC Systems India Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the Un-Audited Financial results ( Standalone & Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
